00:4732bbb216: Whether the world is in an uproar or not, March has come, and with it spring is arriving without fail. The older I get, the more precious this nature becomes to me, where winter gives way to spring and spring brings the flowers into full bloom. Who am I, that God should make the flowers bloom and the snow fall each season and give me the joy of being alive? Love wells up from deep within my heart until my throat grows tight.
00:b1d376501c: My eyes grow hot at the thought that all the truly precious things have been given to me free of charge.
00:99a2580e37: I have spent my whole life rushing about for the sake of a peaceful world, circling the globe I do not know how many times, and yet here in this yard where spring is arriving I taste true peace. Peace, too, is something God has given us freely; where we have lost it, and why we struggle to find it in all the wrong places, I cannot say.
00:bb009a6410: Even now I am full of love that I have not yet been able to give. I offer this book to the world with the prayer that this love will become a river of peace that waters the parched earth and flows to the ends of the world. Recently, more and more people have been asking who I am.
00:59d6d0547e: In particular, since last summer, when the helicopter my wife and I were riding in came within a hair’s breadth of disaster, interest in me seems to have grown throughout the world.
00:640b9168e6: For those who are curious about me, I have looked back over my life and put my honest story into this book. What I have not been able to say here, I hope to be able to tell you at another opportunity.
